这些行为让[from.GetName]行动遭受到推延的风险，但我们必须承认，那个不守规矩的特工的工作事实上对我们相当有用。否认这一努力反而才会减缓我们的进展。
texts.en:
One of our key operatives working on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has become... enamored with the local civilization, and has been refusing many of their assigned tasks. Instead this overly-independent agent has taken up independent xenological study, and has submitted numerous requests to make this a formal posting.

Although these actions put Operation [from.GetName] at risk of delay, we must admit that the unruly operative's work has already proven rather useful to us. Denying this effort will slow our progress.

# 离经叛道 / Side-tracked
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 间谍行动随机插曲（前FTL）pre-FTL espionage operation interlude

## 如何开始 How it starts

随机插曲池（`espionage_event_effects.txt:2908–3260`）：按‘我方普通/格式塔 × 目标普通/蜂巢’分四个池，池内各项权重 1：普通→普通、普通→蜂巢。出现的概率：章节检定失败时 10/400（无外貌改造科技 ×1.5），同一行动 120 天一次。本事件的限制：仅限章节 ≤1 且行动为“植入先进知识”（并非破碎枷锁原文明）。 / Fired from the roll-failure interlude pool (普通→普通、普通→蜂巢): 10-in-400 chance per failed chapter roll, once per 120 days per operation. Restrictions: Only chapter ≤1 and only for plant-advanced-knowledge (not against Broken Shackles’ home species).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**偏离任务（3020）**：一名特工迷上了当地文明，拒绝完成任务，转而独立研究。A 严明纪律（间谍网等级 +3）；B 嘉奖主动性（需要至少 10 点可用间谍能力，间谍网等级 −10，观察站获得 2 年“分心洞察”修正）。 / Side-tracked (3020): an operative goes native. A discipline (+3 spy network level); B commend (needs 10 available spy power, −10 spy network level, 2-year observation_distraction_insights modifier on the outpost).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个选项互斥。 / Two exclusive options.
